findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now an abstract class that cannot be instantiated
findings.body: The handler was changed from a concrete DetectorHandler to StatefulDetectorHandler with an empty body. StatefulDetectorHandler declares counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values and the new build_occurrence_and_event_data as abstract. Any `detector.detector_handler` call for a metric_alert_fire detector will raise TypeError on instantiation. Before this change the handler returned [] harmlessly, so this is a regression.

findings.title: Dict keyed by result.group_key silently overwrites duplicates
findings.body: Results are stored as `results[result.group_key] = result`. The old duplicate-key error log was removed. Because group_values is already a dict, duplicates cannot occur here. A custom handler that returns the same key twice would silently lose results, with no signal.

findings.title: Occurrence produced before state is committed
findings.body: process_detectors produces the Kafka occurrence for each result before calling handler.commit_state_updates(). If the commit raises, an occurrence has already been emitted but the dedupe and state updates are lost. A retry would then emit the occurrence again. The commit is not guarded against this.
